codeReview.summary: Baseline metrics update and no-year unfiltered FTS coverage are present, but the new zero-results tests do not actually verify the required behavior that retrieve() returns an empty list when both channels return zero hits.

issues.description: Feature requirement explicitly says zero-results should return an empty list ([]), but tests only assert non-None/list type and explicitly allow non-empty results (lines 930-931, 947-950). This does not validate the required edge-case contract 'both channels return zero results -> []'.

summary: Reviewed handoff, commit diff (6a99273), transcript skeleton, and skill context. Found a blocking test coverage gap: the zero-results edge-case tests are weaker than the feature contract and do not assert [] when both channels produce no hits.
